stages.notes: Walk: a slow heavy waddle, hips rolling side to side (roll body about 4 degrees), legs short-stepping; swing leg_* at the hip up to 30 degrees and bend shin_* back up to 40. The leg and arm joints are balls buried in fur, safe to 40 degrees about any axis. Idle: dead still, then a small head tilt (head roll or yaw 10 to 15 degrees). Head joint is hidden in the shoulders and by the pearls, which belong to body: keep head pitch within 15 degrees down, 25 up, yaw 40, or the tusks and chin meet the pearls. Arms hang; arm_* can lift 40 forward for the hug, forearm_* bend up to 40. No jaw at this stage. Eyes are googly balls, any angle. Attack: arms open wide then close, head tips back.
